title: PRO/late-effects element set (PROMIS/PRO-CTCAE/PedsQL/EQ-5D-Y)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. Backlog (unscheduled): a PRO/late-effects element set referencing PROMIS/PRO-CTCAE/PedsQL/EQ-5D-Y. Mixed licensing - reference + flag adopter obligations; NO instrument item text without a license. Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define a PRO/late-effects element set bound by reference to PROMIS/PRO-CTCAE/PedsQL/EQ-5D-Y with adopter-obligation flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Elements bound by reference to PROMIS/PRO-CTCAE/PedsQL/EQ-5D-Y; no instrument item text without a license
Per-instrument adopter obligations documented in the license register
